segments.text: Welcome to the Ministry of Manpower.
You're starting a one-month cross-department rotation today.
Your rotation buddy Quin is waiting — and Amazon Quick is ready on your laptop.
⚡ Amazon Quick generated your rotation brief:
Opening: During my rotation across three departments, I observed how AI assistants enhance officer decision-making at each stage of public service delivery.
Key Insight: AI assistants are most valuable when officers lack domain expertise — they provide regulatory knowledge that enables confident judgment.
Recommendation: Include AI assistants in standard onboarding — alongside email and case systems — so using them becomes unremarkable.
The Director reads your brief and smiles: 'Clear, evidence-based, and actionable. Exactly what I needed.'
Quin gives you a thumbs up through the glass. Rotation complete.
Time's up — but you made good progress. The Director will wait for your brief.
